description: Returns the report of a completed Diagnostic by id: the ten pillar scores as the person rated them (side_a_scores) and as detected (side_b_scores), the MIDAS score, executive summary, blind spots, budget and investment reads, business profile, detected tech stack, brand visibility and sentiment, published apps, and a counts-only summary of the AI connectors found. Internal signals are not included. Some detail depends on the account's plan, as the app shows it: on the Free plan the report carries one blind spot (with that pillar's sub-scores only), the brand visibility and sentiment scores without their findings, the stated and estimated tool spend (on older reports, the estimated total) without the per-pillar breakdown, and no market context; the advertising sub-scores also need Starter or above; the investment roadmap (recommended_investment) and published-app identifiers and links need Pro or above (below Pro, published_apps lists only the platforms). A Diagnostic that has not finished returns report_not_ready. Scores for an unchanged site can move a little between runs, so a small change is not on its own evidence that something changed. The findings are what can be observed from outside.
name: get_report
title: Get a Diagnostic report
